name: night-parade
title: Night Parade
description: A survivors game: the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons marches through an abandoned village tonight, and you last until dawn. Six heroes, sixteen weapons that evolve, sixteen items, a fifteen-minute night in three acts with six bosses, a shrine for lasting upgrades, unlocks and harder omens. Built on the Ninja Adventure pack (CC0).
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the whole game is; music and sound keep their own balance in the game's settings.

store.tagline: Last the night against the parade of a hundred demons

actions.title: Smoke dash
actions.description: A short burst you can't be hurt in.

actions.title: Pick at a level-up
actions.description: Or the arrows and Enter; R rerolls, X skips, B banishes.

actions.title: Pause
actions.description: Your build and stats; Q gives up the night.

features: A fifteen-minute night in three acts (Dusk, Midnight, the Hour of the Ox), each with its own crowd, scripted events and a boss: the Tanuki, the Tengu, and the Oni at the head of the parade
Sixteen weapons, each with its own job, eight levels and an evolution when paired with the right item; sixteen items; reroll, skip and banish at level-ups
Six heroes with a starting weapon and a trait, four of them unlocked by playing
Telegraphed danger: rings and lines on the ground before a slam or a charge, a smoke dash to get out
A blessing to choose as Midnight and the Hour of the Ox begin: more damage, more projectiles, more area, armor, healing or speed for the rest of the night
A shrine for lasting upgrades between nights, a codex of everything found and defeated, and omens for harder nights once you've seen the dawn

screenshots.caption: Midnight, 8:06 into the night: shuriken, katana, thunder, fire talisman and spirit wisps against the Act II crowd
10:10, the Tengu arrives; Storm of Stars and Crescent Moon already evolved
A level-up: three choices with what each adds, the item that evolves a weapon you carry starred
A golden chest: the shuriken with its Scroll evolves into Storm of Stars, and four more upgrades
The title, with a night playing behind it
Who walks tonight: six heroes, each with a starting weapon and a trait; four open up by playing

night-parade.title: Night Parade
night-parade.description: A night against the parade. Escape or closing the panel pauses it, and it waits there for you.
